d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar nadvan ganv men shahi taiyariyan, pure ganv ko dulhan ki tarah sajaya ja raha hai...ganv men karib derh kilomitar tak svagat get banae ja rahe hain, shadi ki taiyariyan dekhne ke lie logon ki bhir jut rahi hai.
Dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi se nadvan ganv ki graund riport...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
